The Honest Console

Same lab, every number recomputed from what the engine could actually have known at the moment it printed. Slide the gates and read the consequences.

⚠ Why this exists. The original Console scored every flip against the finished chart. One feature — lead_prior — asked whether a k=3.0 macro swing agreed with the call, but a macro swing is only confirmed a median of 15 sessions after the turn it is anchored on. Read from the future it fired on precisely the calls that worked: it was leaking “did this call pay?” into the score. 13% of flips were also scored against a host trend the tracker had not yet recognised. Every figure on the old Console — and the record that led to choosing this setup — is inflated. Nothing here uses information from after the print.

The gates

Long-first stop-and-reverse on the k=2.75 daily legs (198 pivots, fixed): long from each trough confirmation at the next open; top-call when the retrace from the running high reaches alpha×ATR and the next bar makes no new high; shorts only in the hot-ATR or bear regime or with death corroboration; stops at the stop price; violence prints exit at the print's close. What is live: every knob here, plus the print set — the score threshold, corroboration, violence, risk and death gates above decide which prints reach this engine (the pivot-stop, velocity and k-agreement controls do not apply to it). Provenance: ATR is Wilder-14 on these bars; the bear flag is ; hot-ATR: ATR/close at or above its trailing 97.5th percentile over 2520 sessions. "Base" = this engine with D = 0 and S6b off. Year-by-year below buckets by entry year in this mode, the package's convention.

EXPERIMENTAL — not adopted. Frozen 12 + one composite "extension" feature, refit through 2023-12-31, same math and regularization as the real model. Failed its own +0.02 AUC bar — and the 2026-09-01 audit found its six inputs were ranked on 2024-26 data; a train-only re-selection picks a different six entirely (0/6 overlap) and also fails the bar (+0.018 vs +0.017). Two hand-found March-2026 prints carry about half of its ledger advantage. On every real turn since 2024: scores higher 59% of the time, lower 41% — net effect at this threshold is +3 real turns caught, +2 new false alarms. A real, close tradeoff, not a clean win. Struck-through gold triangles below mark where the two scores disagree on firing.

Veto on SHORT entries only — never tested on longs, so longs pass through unchanged. vel_48h is already one of the 12 scored features (already its largest-magnitude weight); this gate only bites because prints can still clear the score threshold with modest vel_48h. Threshold (3.0) was picked from pre-2023 fired shorts only, never touched 2023+. Out-of-sample effect at these default settings (2021–26, 35% threshold, corroboration on): net +$67/oz (+6%), higher win rate in 4 of the 6 years — but 2023 alone is −$47/oz, the one year this signal didn't hold up in walk-forward testing either. A real, mixed effect, not a clean win every year — see docs/FINDINGS.md 2026-08-30g for the full year-by-year table.

PRESET.
Setups put the controls at an audited starting point — every control above stays live. The three print-feed setups passed an independent adversarial leak/lookahead audit of the machinery (features bit-identical under truncated rebuilds; no lookahead found). The v2.0 setup runs the structure engine of reproduce/run_all.py in this page, validated to reproduce the package's trades.csv to the cent on the package's data; here it consumes the prints the gates above produce. The tables recompute on the data this page carries.

Veto on SHORT entries only — a short must carry host-death corroboration ≥ the frozen q80 bar (0.4286, an existing constant from death_weights.json — chosen over a fitted threshold after the 2026-09-01 audit showed the fitted 0.45 was an in-sample argmax; q80 keeps ~87% of the effect with zero new parameters). The corroboration rule (death≥bar OR p≥0.55) otherwise lets a strong score bypass the death check — the exact hole the Sep–Oct 2025 false shorts came through. Audited on the OG+augmented base: $2,450→$2,739, ex-2026 $487→$804, short win rate 38%→42%, window −$143→−$80. Honest split: +$231 of the gain sits inside the death model's own 2015-23 fit window, +$58 in 2024-26. Not permutation-tested to the production bar — a console gate, not a lock (docs/FINDINGS.md 2026-09-01).

Veto on SHORT entries only — never tested on longs. Requires the flip to ALSO qualify as a scoreable reversal call under the alternate k=2.0 daily episode tracker (binary, no threshold to pick). Validated as a real, permutation-tested ADDITION to the velocity gate above — helps most in 2023, the one year vel_48h alone fell inside the noise band. At default settings (2021–26, 35% threshold, corroboration on): alone, net +$79/oz (+7%); combined with the velocity gate, net +$146/oz (+13%) — the best of any candidate tested, and unlike the others, no year on record gets worse. Top-3 winning trades are IDENTICAL with the gate on or off — the gain comes from fewer/smaller losers, not a lucky big winner. See docs/FINDINGS.md 2026-08-30j/k.

Extension panel

hover the chart

Six oscillators, direction-agnostic, causal through the session shown. This is the family that carried real independent signal in the arsenal round (2026-08-29f) and was pegged near its most extreme reading at both the 2026-03-03 top and the 2026-03-27 bottom — cases the frozen score under-weighted (2026-08-30b). None of this feeds the score; it's a second, independent read for a human to weigh alongside it.

Did the flag mean anything?

Every scoreable flip in range, scored leak-free, split by whether it fired at the current gates and what actually happened next. “Real” = the flip landed on the host's final extreme and that trend was superseded. “Paid” = ≥3% favourable within 22 sessions.

The book

Hold until the opposite print; the stop sits at the pivot. Entries at the print's session close — no profit target, no timeout.
